mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.password, COALESCE(d.permission, 0) AS deptPermission, COALESCE(j.permission, 0) AS jobPermission FROM user_tbl u LEFT JOIN permission_dept_tbl d ON u.dept_tbl_id = d.dept_tbl_id LEFT JOIN permission_job_tbl j ON u.job_tbl_id = j.job_tbl_id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT s.route, s.param_name AS paramName, s.param_value AS paramValue, p.name AS programName, COALESCE(l.dept_level, 0) AS deptLevel, COALESCE(l.job_level, 0) AS jobLevel FROM screen s JOIN program p ON s.program_id = p.program_id LEFT JOIN permission_program_tbl l ON l.program_id = p.program_id WHERE s.route = #{route} ORDER BY s.param_name IS NULL, s.screen_id

SELECT NULL AS route, NULL AS paramName, NULL AS paramValue, p.name AS programName, COALESCE(l.dept_level, 0) AS deptLevel, COALESCE(l.job_level, 0) AS jobLevel FROM program p LEFT JOIN permission_program_tbl l ON l.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.program_id = #{programId}
